updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access Integration (General Availability)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. Admins can enforce restrictive DLP actions and detect risky user activity through Insider Risk Management, extending data protection beyond traditional Microsoft 365 boundaries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Expanded Diagnostics Access to Additional Roles
updates.summary: Diagnostics access in the Purview Compliance Portal is now available to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator, and Organization Management roles, no longer limited to Global Admin. This broadens operational visibility for security and compliance teams managing their environments.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations Integration
updates.summary: Security admins can now launch pre-scoped Data Security Investigations directly from Insider Risk Management cases to analyze content and assess post-incident data impact. This integration strengthens the ability to investigate potential insider threats and understand the scope of data exposure.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Collection Policies Support
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management now supports collection policies, allowing admins to scope classification and activities for specific users. Compliance teams should review existing collection policies to ensure they capture the activities required by their IRM policies.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Microsoft Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge now integrates with Conditional Access and removes previous policy restrictions. Admins gain access to expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and improved alert visibility in Activity Explorer.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends browser inline protection to a broader set of unmanaged generative AI applications in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through these apps, improving consistency of data security controls.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: DLP now supports aggregating alerts based on common user entities even when multiple rules match, consolidating related violations into a single alert. This reduces alert noise, simplifies investigation workflows, and provides better contextual understanding of violations.

updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Pre-Curated File Extension List
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for policy conditions, eliminating manual free-form entry that could lead to gaps or processing overhead. This improves policy reliability and reduces unnecessary endpoint processing.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Admins can now include file archiving actions in Purview data retention policies for SharePoint Online, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining compliance and discoverability. This provides cost optimization alongside retention and deletion actions.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Policy Recommendations on Sensitive Microsoft 365 Data
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights on sensitive data stored in OneDrive and SharePoint, along with targeted recommendations for retention policies. Admins can improve their data security and compliance posture by leveraging these recommendations to better govern sensitive assets.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview introduces a single unified interface for discovering, creating, validating, and managing all classifiers—including Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers. This simplifies classifier management and improves governance consistency across the platform.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identities and elevate privileges over a network. Organizations using Dataverse should apply available security updates to mitigate this exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identities and elevate privileges over a network. Organizations using Fabric for data analytics and governance should apply security patches promptly.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Authorization Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Container Registry through user-controlled keys allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges. Container registry administrators should review and apply available security updates to restrict unauthorized access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authentication vulnerability in Azure AI Foundry for a critical function allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Organizations deploying AI Foundry should apply available patches to enforce proper authentication controls.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Azure Machine Learning allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Teams managing Azure ML workspaces should review access controls and apply security updates.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Improper Authorization Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows authorized attackers to escalate their privileges beyond their intended scope. Database administrators should review user permissions and apply available security patches.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Scope Change for Copilot
updates.summary: Existing Teams retention policies that currently also govern Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer implicitly applying to Copilot workloads. Admins should review and update retention policies if they intend to cover Copilot data independently.
